negative_reviews.author: Cameron O'Neill
negative_reviews.text: Didn’t order ramen or sushi, therefore I have to be fair and not give 1 star. But honestly, the tempura squid tasted rotten and I requested a refund for that as it was ransid. Spat it out straight away tasted like death. Other than that the gyozas were mid level quality and the teriyaki chicken was nice. Just totally put off by the squid. Oh and the final bill come to nearly £60 for a few sides and two drinks!!! Overpriced and low quality. Personally would never come here again.
